text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Dober is frantically trying<n>to pull herself
out of her rut, Air<n>Groove happens by and asks to
talk.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
During her conversation with Air<n>Groove, Mejiro
Dober admits she's<n>afraid of breaking her promise
to<n>Mejiro Bright and of betraying<n>people's
expectations of her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Air Groove points out that those<n>fears are really
a reflection of her<n>progress. After all, those
expectant<n>fans wouldn't be there if she wasn't
working so hard to keep her promise.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While her fears and tremors still linger<n>after that
talk, Mejiro Dober decides<n>to run in the Japanese
Oaks for all the<n>people that support her!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she declares her plan, I can see a<n>bright light
shining in her eyes, and<n>that makes me confident
that Mejiro<n>Dober will get through this.
